endorsements.name: Ryan Holeman
endorsements.label: Passive Bluetooth Monitoring in Scapy
endorsements.description: Recognizing a need to support passive bluetooth monitoring in Scapy, Python's interactive monitoring framework, a project was launched to produce this functionality. Through this functionality, a new means for interactively observing bluetooth was created along with Python APIs to assist in the development of bluetooth auditing, pentesting and exploitation tools.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2012

evidence-links.title: Black Hat USA 2012 - Passive Bluetooth Monitoring in Scapy

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
